component.name: Bars
component.summary: Private, on-device voice dictation for every app

description.p: Hold a shortcut, speak, and let go: Bars transcribes your voice with a fast local speech model and types the text into whatever app you are using. Nothing is sent over the network.

ul.li: Push-to-talk or hands-free dictation from a global shortcut
NVIDIA Parakeet and Canary models running on your CPU via ONNX Runtime
Removes filler words, supports a personal dictionary and snippets
Lives in the system tray with a minimal recording indicator
